name: P-loop superfamily domain-bait scan
description: Enumerate every UniProt protein InterPro annotates with a P-loop pore model, then classify what comes back. The pfam list is deliberately the union of seven pore models rather than PF00520 alone: measured 2026-08-19, TRPC3, TRPM8, MCOLN1 and PKD2 carry no PF00520 at all, so a PF00520-only enumeration silently loses most of the TRP division (hazard H7). Excludes nothing by name — the exclusions are the classifier's job, and a scan that filters by symbol cannot find an unnamed gene model.
